notes: TROOP 0.4.3 replaces the pixelated close world map with smooth 320 px satellite tiles, a photoreal natural-detail layer, and higher-quality mipmapped 4K Earth and Moon imagery. Shared-edge terrain reconstruction removes square block seams while staged texture uploads and a 1,500-sample-per-tile ceiling make zoom refinement much faster and keep it frame-bounded. This is a protocol-9-compatible signed content update: TROOP 0.4.2 downloads it automatically in the background and activates it on a safe restart, with no installer required.
